entries.235dfa053d57e6b8: The company provides the cloud-based text mining tool 'Mieruka Enjin' and the cloud-based customer development CRM system 'Kasutamārings.' It analyzes information such as customer voices and purchase data, and supports improvements to products and services and the implementation of marketing measures. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥3,839 million.
entries.2b971762fa23b23f: The group consists of the company and 4 consolidated subsidiaries (Grow Up Co., Ltd., Attack Co., Ltd., Dee Fo Dee Aru Co., Ltd. and OM Network Co., Ltd.), and provides SaaS-type solutions based on text mining technology. The head office is in Higashi-Shimbashi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, and the number of consolidated employees as of September 30, 2025 is 469. The business is divided into 2 reportable segments: Marketing Solutions and HR Solutions.
